definitions.gloss: to let pass; to ignore what one hears
definitions.explanation: to hear something but deliberately not react or respond to it
to listen without paying full attention, often as background

notes:
{聞|き}き{流|なが}す has two main uses: deliberately ignoring what you hear, or casual background listening.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (す-verb)
- Transitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear/listen) + ⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧ (to let flow)
- Literally: to let what you hear flow away

SENSE 1 (IGNORING):
- Deliberate choice not to react
- Often a coping strategy for criticism
- {聞|き}き{流|なが}す⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}る→限る：02033_kagiru⟧ (best to ignore) is a common phrase

SENSE 2 (BACKGROUND LISTENING):
- Not paying full attention
- Common with music, radio, podcasts
- Neutral/positive connotation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{嫌味|いやみ}→嫌味：07024_iyami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{流|なが}す (let snide remarks pass)
- ⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{流|なが}す (let gossip pass)
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{流|なが}す (ignore advice)
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{流|なが}す (have music on in background)
- BGM⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{流|なが}す (have background music playing)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{流|なが}す (let go in one ear and out the other)
- {聞|き}き{流|なが}す⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧ (English for passive listening - book/course title pattern)
